commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak 34 score and the Nifty 50 surrendering critical support amid heavy foreign institutional distribution, Stan Weinstein's Stage discipline demands utmost caution. In William O'Neil's CANSLIM framework, a market under correction heavily impairs breakout follow-through across leading sectors. Jesse Livermore preached never fighting the general tide, meaning capital preservation takes absolute priority. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure discipline dictates keeping total portfolio risk constrained and trade sizes modest. Only elite Stage 2 names displaying standout relative strength and accelerating earnings warrant tracking, while stops must remain unforgiving.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA | O'Neil CANSLIM | Weinstein Stage Analysis | Darvas & Livermore Disciplines

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price holds above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, carving a 26.6% deep cup with a 6.5% handle. While the double-bottom pattern exhibits constructive contraction, broader volume confirmation is lacking, and RSI at 55 reflects neutral relative strength.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Dismal quarterly top-line collapse of 56% YoY and net profit dropping 25% YoY to ₹1.02 Cr. Weak ROCE (5.6%) and low operating margins undermine the technical bottoming attempt, failing CANSLIM's fundamental baseline.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Failure below the swing low stop of ₹95.95 violates the base support, requiring an immediate stop-out to protect capital.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Textbook Stage 2 continuation. Price cleared the 20-day high to mark fresh 52-week highs above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. RSI at 66 shows healthy momentum without being overextended, demonstrating standout relative strength.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Powerhouse CANSLIM profile: Q1 FY27 net profit jumped 54% YoY alongside 38% revenue growth. Robust operating margins near 20% and an expanding ROCE support the new-high breakout, backed by rising institutional sponsorship.
AARTIPHARM.risk: A decisive breakdown below the ₹869.10 pivot stop invalidates the breakout box, triggering an immediate defensive exit.

ABBOTINDIA.technical: Trading firmly above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, pressing within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on heavy 2.52x volume. RSI at 69 reflects strong defensive institutional accumulation during broader market weakness.
ABBOTINDIA.fundamental: High-grade defensive franchise boasting ROCE of ~47%, ROE of ~35%, and virtually zero debt. However, modest mid-teens profit growth and low single-digit revenue expansion (+4%) miss CANSLIM's high-velocity 25%/15% growth criteria.
ABBOTINDIA.risk: Reversal below ₹27,710.37 breaches key moving averages, signaling institutional distribution and demanding strict capital preservation.

ACE.technical: Formed a constructive double bottom above rising 21, 50, and 200-day moving averages. MACD is positive and RSI at 72 highlights dominant relative strength, though nearing short-term resistance at the ₹1,269.27 entry trigger.
ACE.fundamental: Market leader in mobile cranes benefiting from industrial capex. Solid ROCE (31.6%), clean debt-free balance sheet, and robust 20% sales growth offset slightly sub-25% EPS expansion (+22%), maintaining strong institutional backing.
ACE.risk: Violation of ₹1,190.33 undercuts the double bottom swing low, mandating an immediate cut of the position.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Hovering within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on 1.74x average volume, holding comfortably above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI at 63 reflects controlled, constructive consolidation without signs of late-stage exhaustion.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Dominant infrastructure moat with top-tier EBITDA margins near 60% and solid revenue growth (+19% YoY), driven by international expansion. Moderating net profit growth (+10% YoY) and elevated leverage keep CANSLIM scores measured.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Failure below the ₹1,790.95 stop level breaches structural swing support, requiring prompt Minervini-style risk mitigation.

AEROFLEX.technical: Exemplary leadership action. After easing into its rising 21-EMA on light dry-up volume, price delivered a bullish reclaim candle with neckline pressure, holding well above SMA50 and SMA200 in a clean double bottom.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Stellar CANSLIM profile with triple-digit profit explosion (+162% YoY), 72% top-line surge, and operating margins expanding to 24%. Low debt, strong return metrics, and high-margin product expansion validate genuine institutional accumulation.
AEROFLEX.risk: A break below ₹528.75 breaches the 21-EMA and pattern baseline, mandating a rapid loss cut per SEPA discipline.
